commander_specific_hypothesis: Aurora Phoenix has printed cascade and returns from graveyard to hand whenever another spell with cascade is cast; Abaddon-granted cascade spells should enable this trigger.
expected_benefit: More commander-first cascade density and repeatable recovery; six mana value matches the proposed cut.
tradeoff: Loses Mind's Desire's explosive storm-value ceiling; Aurora Phoenix is a smaller body and requires it to reach the graveyard for recursion.

tradeoff: Cuts a low-cost damage engine that can repeatedly ping opponents on instant/sorcery casts and help raise Abaddon's threshold; the swap is not yet a clear net upgrade.
